preconditions.description: The number of nodes n and the length of the path k are within the specified bounds.

postconditions.description: The minimum number of colors needed is at least 2.
The total number of edges is correctly calculated.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= color <= c for color in coloring)
postconditions.description: All edge colors are within the valid range of colors.

postconditions.expression: all(coloring[i] != coloring[j] for i < j if (i, j) and (j, i) are edges)
postconditions.description: No two edges with the same start and end nodes have the same color.

postconditions.expression: all(coloring[i] == coloring[j] for i, j in rainbow_paths)
postconditions.description: All paths of length k or longer are rainbow paths.

invariants.expression: coloring is a list of integers representing the colors of edges
invariants.description: The coloring list is used to represent the edge colors.

invariants.expression: rainbow_paths is a list of tuples representing paths of length k or longer
invariants.description: The rainbow_paths list is used to represent the paths that need to be rainbow.
